aria.sea: The sea. Tap to sail, tap the enemy to attack, hold to board.

brief.eyebrow: Off Galle, Ceylon · March 1640 · practice fight
brief.title: The Zeehond
brief.text: A Dutch warship, the Zeehond, is hunting Portuguese traders north of Galle. Take the patacho São Brás out and stop her: sink her, make her strike her colours, or board her.
brief.how1: Tap the sea to set a course. You can’t sail straight into the wind; the ship will zig-zag.
brief.how2: Tap the Dutch ship to attack. Your guns fire on their own when she’s inside a gold arc.
brief.how3: Hit her bow or stern (raking) for 1.5× damage.
brief.how4: Hold your finger on her, or tap Board, to grapple. She must be slowed below 60% speed first.
brief.how5: Pause any time with the button or a two-finger tap. Orders still work.
brief.note: Test build of the first fight. Ships, sea and sound are all made by code.

toast.aground: Ran aground! The hull is damaged.
toast.noEnemy: No enemy in sight to board
toast.fastOff: Enemy in sight: fast time is off

hint.start: Tap the sea to set a course. A lookout reports sails to the north.
hint.tack: You can’t sail straight into the wind, so the ship zig-zags (tacks) toward the point.
hint.seen: Tap the Dutch ship to attack. Your guns fire on their own when she is inside a gold arc.
hint.fired: Fire! Each side reloads on its own: watch the gold bars on your ship card.
hint.rake: Raking: a broadside into her bow or stern does 1.5× damage.
hint.bow: Bow guns: 2 small guns that fire straight ahead, for chasing.
hint.flee: She is running for the edge of the chart. Chain shot slows her; if she gets away, she escapes.
hint.board: She is slow now. Hold your finger on her, or tap Board, to grapple and board.
hint.tooFast: Too fast to grapple: she must be below 60% speed. Chain shot slows her.
hint.tooFastOrder: She must be below 60% speed to grapple. Chain shot slows her.
hint.keep: Keep away: your ship holds about 300 off the enemy and turns its broadside to her by itself.
hint.grape: Grape shot only reaches 150: it kills crew before you board.
hint.chain: Chain shot tears sails and slows her down.
hint.battleSail: Battle sail: slower, but you turn faster and your sails take half the damage.

clash.title: Boarding!
clash.start: Grappling hooks fly. Pick a tactic for each round; watch what their officer does.
clash.log: Round {n}: your {ours} against their {theirs}. {edge} You lose {lp} men, they lose {le}.

result.won-sunkText: Her hull gave way under your broadsides. No prize, but the coast is safe for now.
result.won-struckText: Her crew lost heart and surrendered. In the full game she would become your prize.
result.won-capturedText: Your boarders carried her deck. In the full game she could join your fleet or be sold.
result.lost-sunkText: Her broadsides were too much. Try raking her from the bow or stern, and keep your distance with battle sails.
result.lost-capturedText: Her crew carried your deck. Thin her crew with grape shot before you board.
result.escapedText: She ran for open sea. Chain shot on her sails would have kept her in reach.
result.askTitle: Tell Claude, in a few words:
result.ask1: Did the angled view feel as good as the flat chart fight, or better?
result.ask2: Could you always tell which way each ship was facing?
result.ask3: Did you ever tap the wrong ship, or the sea instead of a ship?
result.ask4: Too easy, too hard, or about right?
